scope: C native production migration/repository input matrix expansion. SQL-level synthetic row preservation; JSON payloads explicitly marked SQL fixtures, NOT domain-valid business acceptance or combined A/B/C runtime.

cases.expected: readonly identify and actual repository must reject; no upgrade, no registry writes; file and directory unchanged

objects.name: agent_run
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE agent_run (
  run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workspace(id),
  operation_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  request_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  data_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(data_json)),
  execution_id TEXT,
  worker_session_id TEXT,
  UNIQUE(workspace_id, operation_key),
  CHECK(json_extract(data_json, '$.runId') = run_id),
  CHECK(json_extract(data_json, '$.operationKey') = operation_key),
  CHECK((json_extract(data_json, '$.status') = 'running') = (execution_id IS NOT NULL AND worker_session_id IS NOT NULL))
)

  PRIMARY KEY(workspace_id, control_key)
)

objects.name: agent_write_call
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE agent_write_call (
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES agent_run(run_id),
  tool_call_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  attempt INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(attempt>0),
  execution_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  worker_session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  tool_name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(tool_name IN ('create_draft','apply_patch')),
  request_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  input_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(input_json)),
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('prepared','committed','abandoned')),
  revision_id TEXT, validation_json TEXT CHECK(validation_json IS NULL OR json_valid(validation_json)),
  PRIMARY KEY(run_id,tool_call_id),
  CHECK((status='committed') = (revision_id IS NOT NULL))
)

objects.name: agent_run
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE agent_run (
  run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workspace(id),
  operation_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  request_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  data_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(data_json)),
  execution_id TEXT,
  worker_session_id TEXT,
  UNIQUE(workspace_id, operation_key),
  CHECK(json_extract(data_json, '$.runId') = run_id),
  CHECK(json_extract(data_json, '$.operationKey') = operation_key),
  CHECK((json_extract(data_json, '$.status') = 'running') = (execution_id IS NOT NULL AND worker_session_id IS NOT NULL))
)

objects.name: agent_write_call
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE agent_write_call (
  run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES agent_run(run_id),
  tool_call_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  attempt INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(attempt>0),
  execution_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  worker_session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  tool_name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(tool_name IN ('create_draft','apply_patch')),
  request_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  input_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(input_json)),
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('prepared','committed','abandoned')),
  revision_id TEXT, validation_json TEXT CHECK(validation_json IS NULL OR json_valid(validation_json)),
  PRIMARY KEY(run_id,tool_call_id),
  CHECK((status='committed') = (revision_id IS NOT NULL))
)
